headlines.text: That Friday in 2021, Trent Beretta kicked off their AEW journey against Best Friends & Cassidy vs. The SuperKliq vs. Best Friends vs. The Young Bucks vs. Chuck Taylor vs. Orange Cassidy vs. Rocky Romero vs. Adam Cole vs. Matt Jackson vs. Nick Jackson vs. Bobby Fish, appearing on Rampage, rated 7.34 ? a solid showing. On this day in 2025, it marked the first-ever meeting between The Elite and Hechicero, Okada & Takeshita on Dynamite, rated 7.94 ? a strong outing.
Back on this day in 2025, PAC vs. Kyle Fletcher met in a Continental Classic League Match on Dynamite, rated 7.89 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle ? part of that year's Holiday Bash '25 - Night 1.

secondaries.text: Rewind to 2025, when Bandido vs. Ricochet vs. Ace Austin vs. Anthony Bowens vs. Bishop Kaun vs. Brody King vs. Josh Alexander vs. Luchasaurus vs. Mark Davis vs. Max Caster vs. Shelton Benjamin vs. Toa Liona settled things in a Battle Royal match, closing out the card as the main event on Dynamite, rated 4.61 ? part of that year's Holiday Bash '25 - Night 1.
